summary: Configure IPv6 and dual-stack chain networking with explicit endpoint evidence
details: Resolve setup auto selection once, or explicitly choose IPv4, IPv6 P2P publication or dual stack. Existing configurations retain IPv4 until an operator selects a new profile.

Attach only chain to an additional IPv6-enabled NAT bridge with explicit gateway priority, publish both TCP and UDP, and retain loopback-only operator APIs and the existing shared data-service network.

Apply transport edits through the durable peer operation, preserving seeds, data, node key and bound mining authorization. Check host IPv6, Docker support and managed firewall before stopping the old chain; reject mismatched container publication before reporting applied.

Show family-specific enode candidates separately from actual container configuration, with public reachability explicitly unverified. Advertised addresses do not replace the Geth NAT setting or guarantee multi-endpoint discovery/failover.

The paired go-ethereum change preserves a contacted endpoint when a validated ENR prefers another address family, while retaining signature and identity checks. Real Docker 29 acceptance covers signed UDP pong and RLPx TCP through host-published ports, profile recreation, identity preservation and internal IPv4 links; external two-host validation remains required.

Require accept_ra=2 on interfaces supplying RA default routes before enabling IPv6: Docker forwarding otherwise suppresses router advertisements and the host route expires. Auto mode reports the condition and falls back to IPv4; explicit IPv6 fails before network creation.
operator_actions: Deploy the paired node kit and chain image. IPv6 profiles require rootful Linux Docker Engine >=28.0.0, Compose >=2.33.1, stable host IPv6, default routing and TCP/UDP ingress rules.

Use peers configure --ip-family dual or ipv6, with explicit advertised addresses/ports where needed; observe peers status and peers network. Share candidates with peers enode and verify from another node before relying on public reachability.
For an RA-derived IPv6 default route, have the host administrator persist accept_ra=2 on the actual external interface before selecting IPv6. The node tool checks but does not modify host sysctls.
